title: Amenable traces on C*-algebras
summary: Tracial states of arbitrary C*-algebras with their GNS data, completely positive contractions into matrix algebras measured by the normalized trace and its 2-norm, and the amenable, quasidiagonal and uniform amenable traces: the Connes–Kirchberg characterization by hypertraces, the minimal norm on A ⊙ Aᵒᵖ and completely positive extensions into π_τ(A)'', Connes's Følner condition, the injectivity characterization of uniform amenable traces, the nuclear and exact theorems, faces and permanence, the finite-dimensional, commutative, AF and group examples, quasidiagonal traces versus quasidiagonal algebras, and the necessity half of the AF-embedding theorem.

layers.title: Tracial states, their GNS data and the matrix trace

targets.name: IsTracialState
targets.statement: A tracial state of a C*-algebra A is a state τ : A →P[ℂ] ℂ (norm one) with τ(ab) = τ(ba) for all a, b ∈ A; T(A) is the set of tracial states with the weak-star topology of S(A).
hypotheses: A a NonUnitalCStarAlgebra with PartialOrder and StarOrderedRing

api.name: ext / coercion
api.statement: Two tracial states with equal values are equal; membership is the conjunction of the state and trace conditions.

api.name: polarization criterion
api.statement: A state is tracial iff τ(a*a) = τ(aa*) for all a.

api.name: unitary invariance
api.statement: For unital A a state is tracial iff τ(uau*) = τ(a) for all unitaries u.

api.name: convexity
api.statement: Convex combinations of tracial states are tracial states.

api.name: closure and compactness
api.statement: T(A) is weak-star closed in S(A), compact for nonzero unital A.

api.name: pullback
api.statement: For a star homomorphism ι : A → B and τ ∈ T(B), τ ∘ ι is a tracial positive functional, a tracial state when it has norm one (ι unital or surjective).

for the ideal statement: I a closed two-sided ideal of A

δ ≤ 1/8 and ‖φ(1)‖ > 2δ (for instance tr_k φ(1) > 2δ) for the norm version

layers.title: Amenable, quasidiagonal and uniform amenable traces

targets.name: IsAmenableTrace
targets.statement: τ ∈ T(A) is amenable if for every finite F ⊆ A and ε > 0 there are k and a c.p.c. φ : A → M_k with ‖φ(ab) − φ(a)φ(b)‖₂ < ε and |tr_k φ(a) − τ(a)| < ε for a, b ∈ F.
